label: D1 after an unrewarded a1 -> S1 trial, weaker if the trial before was rewarded or late in episode
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is('a1 S1 u') ;; (phase == D1) * last_is('a1 S1 u') * (tv('reward', -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is('a1 S1 u') * ep_dec
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * ep_dec ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * (tv("action", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (tv("reward", -3) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (ep_trial < 3)
explanation: Sparse feature (2% of steps), active only at D1. The main driver is the previous trial being a common a1 -> S1 transition that went unrewarded (residual +0.32, every other previous-trial pattern is about -0.03). Within that case it is much stronger when the trial before was also unrewarded (a loss streak), and it falls off over the episode (ep_dec). The free fit adds smaller effects: stronger if a1 was also chosen two trials back, a slight rise with belief_lo (observer still leaning S1), and a weak boost for three unrewarded trials in a row. It also keeps firing on later D1s of an unrewarded streak that started with an S1 loss (e.g. after a2 S1 u or a2 S2 u), and the history terms only partly capture this. GO and D2 are always zero. No future, hidden or model-output variables are used.

issues: Each claim checks out on the test split. The single term last_is('a1 S1 u') at D1 gets 0.237. Adding the 'trial before rewarded' term raises it to 0.306 (weight -0.32). Adding ep_dec on its own raises it to 0.344 (weight -0.075 per decile). All three terms together give 0.407. The feature is exactly zero at GO and D2, so 'only at D1' holds.

The 'trial before rewarded' factor is partly a window-edge artifact. tv('reward',-2)==1 lumps windows with unknown history (tv = -9) in with the unrewarded ones. Splitting them out shows the unknown cases sit in between (weights: r-2=0 +0.60, unknown +0.31, r-2=1 +0.16). Writing the term as (tv('reward',-2)==0), meaning 'stronger after two losses in a row', scores higher: test 0.423 vs 0.407.

Remaining systematic miss: the worst-fit windows are early-episode runs of unrewarded a2 -> S1 (rare) trials, and the D1 right after such runs. There the feature fires at 1.0-1.7 but the prediction is about 0.07. On average the a2 S1 u class is small (residual -0.018), so this is a minority pattern. Targeted terms did not recover it: a2 S1 u * r-2 unrewarded gives 0.306, and the generic loss-streak term gives 0.307-0.318. The explanation already admits this pattern is only partly captured.

Otherwise misses show no large error class, only a uniform -0.025 over-prediction at D1 for every other previous-trial pattern. belief_lo, |belief_lo| and belief_cover add nothing within the a1 S1 u case (each moves the score by less than 0.001 or lowers it).
